title: rnaseq-nf samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet CSV used as input to the rnaseq-nf pipeline.

sample_id.errorMessage: sample_id must be provided and cannot contain spaces.

fastq_1.description: Path to FASTQ file for read 1. Must be gzipped or uncompressed.
fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz', '.fastq.gz', '.fq' or '.fastq'.

fastq_2.description: Path to FASTQ file for read 2. Must be gzipped or uncompressed.
fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz', '.fastq.gz', '.fq' or '.fastq'.
